pages.text: Scorpions come in red, black, blue and, rarely, gold. Their sting poisons for a few seconds, and they eat meat. Wear gold and they leave you alone.$(br2)Feed one a pottery sherd and its sting changes. See the last pages.

pages.name: Red
pages.text: Deserts and badlands. A burn sherd shows on its back.

pages.name: Gold
pages.text: One in a hundred. It holds a grudge and eats golden spider eyes.

$(item)Assimilating a sherd$()$(br)Offer an adult scorpion a pottery sherd. It absorbs it, and the sherd shows on its back.$(br2)Its sting now carries a venom for about two minutes. A scorpion holds one sherd, and keeps it when caught.

$(item)Venoms (1/2)$()$(br)Angler: glowing$(br)Archer: arrows hurt more$(br)Arms Up: no critical blows$(br)Blade: no sweeping$(br)Brewer: purges effects$(br)Burn: on fire$(br)Danger: blasts hurt more$(br)Explorer: no sprinting$(br)Flow: no swimming$(br)Friend: Hatred$(br)Guster: huge knockback$(br)Heart: no natural healing

$(item)Venoms (2/2)$()$(br)Heartbreak: creatures flee$(br)Howl: wild wolves attack$(br)Miner: cannot mine$(br)Mourner: cannot kill$(br)Plenty: cannot open chests$(br)Prize: Fortune ignored$(br)Scrape: no axe scraping$(br)Sheaf: no bone meal$(br)Shelter: no placing blocks$(br)Skull: 3 fewer hearts$(br)Snort: cannot hide
